Subject: AWS listing: branding claims + SLA evidence needed

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick walkthrough on Friday. We're ready to move the listing into the marketplace validation queue but need a few compliance items before we can schedule the co-sell enablement review: 

1) Confirm marketing copy that contains availability/uptime claims (we require certified wording or evidence for any 99.x% statements).
2) Finalized brand assets (logo variations PNG/SVG) and a short usage runbook — we typically check color space and placement on screenshots.
3) Support coverage matrix showing on-call/24x7 vs business-hours support and escalation SLAs (time-to-first-response for P1/P2).
4) A redline or executable copy of the customer-facing SLA you intend to publish in the listing.

If you can drop those by EOD Thursday (US-PST) the marketplace team can keep the co-sell kickoff on track for the week of 3/19. I attached a checklist template below for reference.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Marketplace Partnerships — AWS

Sofia / team — quick updates and proposed redlines. I attached the redline doc for the public-facing SLA (acme_redlines_v1.docx) and an exported uptime summary for the last 12 months. High level: 

- SLA claim: recommend changing the phrasing to “aims for 99.9% availability” in the marketplace copy and keep the contractual SLA (for customers under Dedicated) at 99.9% with credits. Rationale: marketplace listings are public and AWS enforces strict evidence when an absolute claim is present.
- Evidence: attached uptime_export_12m.csv (referenced inside the doc) shows 99.88% rolling — acceptable for public-facing phrasing but borderline for an absolute 99.9% claim.
- Support matrix: Laura, I drafted initial times — please confirm islands/holiday coverage. I added a fallback escalation to Redwood CS on weekends (point to on-call primary and backup).

Next steps I propose: 
1) Publish a marketplace-friendly public blurb with “target/aims for 99.9%” language.
2) Provide Rajiv the brand assets (Marissa) + the runbook.
3) Laura to finalize support_window_matrix.xlsx and share rota.
4) Sofia to confirm and send the bundle to Rajiv; ask for formal validation slot.

Attachments: acme_redlines_v1.docx; uptime_export_12m.csv

— Ben
